fields.v: Spec-First Agentic Engineering architecture (no version): five pillars: (1) spec as source of truth (code and proofs as disposable build outputs); (2) zero human code review gated by CI; (3) Verification IR (VIR) lowered by a thin verified translator; (4) extensional Computational Type Theory (CTT) specs + HOAS in the VIR; (5) two-tier agent fleet (Personal Spec-Copilots + Shared Synthesis Fleet). Builds on author's salt, SaltBench, x86lean, MetaPRL
